description: Diagnostic-only replay of manually reviewed no-box capture intervals. Original decoded crop pixels are unchanged. These clips are selected historical failure frames, not clean continuous acceptance.
annotation_method: All forty capture frames were individually visually inspected. Subtitle line ROIs were manually chosen; bright neutral pixels aided line envelopes with 1px antialias margin. Every complete movie crop also had zero pixels matching even the relaxed green-border screen (G>50 and G>B+25 and G>R+25). No green was erased. Rectangles and frame intervals are half-open.
limitations: Diagnostic split only: biased selection of four historical missing-box intervals totaling forty 60Hz capture frames.
Post-render screen RGB is not original 4K input or original luma/transfer representation.

Each short interval starts a fresh probe process without the acquired cue, preceding bar reference or following recovery frame. It cannot establish temporal continuity or validate the observed hold/dropout fix.
60Hz capture repeats 23.976Hz input. Use default 24000/1001 sampling; do not count capture duplicates as independent confirmation. The three-frame interval may yield only one probe observation.
No source onset is annotated and no first-frame acquisition claim is supported.
Existing source subtitle translucent panel is retained. Full neighboring frames contain green borders and are deliberately excluded, never erased.

Use --report-only. Optionally --lookahead 0 diagnoses immediate fresh acquisition; the normal lookahead diagnostic has too few independent frames to judge production tracking. Do not supply reviewed bars except in a separately labelled bar-extraction diagnostic.

contamination: post-render RGB capture; no diagnostic green pixels in selected crop
